dialog.english:
Kari couldn't possibly be the
eighth child, could she?
dialog.translation:
No puede ser que Kari sea el
octavo Niño Elegido, no?

dialog.english: Let's hurry up and go see Kari.
dialog.translation: Venga, vamos a ver a Kari.

dialog.english: ...Yeah.

By the way, Koromon, there's
something I need to tell you.
dialog.translation:
Por cierto, Koromon, tengo que
decirte una cosa.

dialog.english: What is it, Tai?

From now on, you're a doll. I
mean, you have to pretend to be a
doll!
dialog.translation:
Desde ahora eres un muñeco.
Bueno, finge ser un muñeco!

dialog.english: A doll...?

Uh, I mean... you can't talk, and
you can't move around in front of
people!
dialog.translation:
Bueno, digo... no puedes hablar,
ni moverte delante de la gente!

dialog.english: Got it! I'm a doll, I'm a doll!
dialog.translation: Vale! Soy un muñeco, un muñeco!

dialog.english: I'm worried...
Hm? Is that your house, Tai?
dialog.translation: Eh? Es esa tu casa, Tai?

dialog.english:
No, mine's on the other side... I
got a little too nervous.
dialog.translation:
No, la mía está al otro lado...
Me puse un poco nervioso.

dialog.english:
I mean, it's *my* house, but...
well, let's go!
dialog.translation:
Bueno, sí que es mi casa,
pero... vamos!

dialog.english: Wow, Tai, your house is big!
dialog.translation: Vaya, Tai, tu casa es enorme!

dialog.english:
No, no, my house isn't the
whole... well, whatever.
dialog.translation:
No, no, mi casa no es todo
eso... bueno, da igual.

dialog.english:
(This is the second time we're
come back here, but...)
dialog.translation:
(Es la segunda vez que
volvemos aquí, pero...)

dialog.english:
(I wonder if Kari and Mom and
Dad are here, like they should
be...)
dialog.translation:
(Me pregunto si Kari, mamá y
papá estarán aquí, como
deberían...)

dialog.english: (Why am I so worried about this?)

Ah, Tai, are you back from
summer camp?
dialog.translation:
Ah, Tai, ya has vuelto del
campamento?

dialog.english:
Y-yeah! They sent us home early
because of abnormal weather, you
know.
dialog.translation:
S-sí! Nos mandaron a casa antes
por culpa del tiempo tan raro.

dialog.english:
Speaking of which, the news said
that there was a sudden snowstorm.
dialog.translation:
Por cierto, las noticias
dijeron que hubo una ventisca
de repente.

dialog.english: A snowstorm!? Was it Frigimon!?
Aaaack! Y-you idiot!

Hey, Tai! Ah! What are you
doing!? *mfffghghhhgg*
dialog.translation:
Oye, Tai! Ah! Qué haces!?
Mfffghghhhgg

dialog.english: I keep telling you not to move!
dialog.translation: Que no te muevas, te digo!

dialog.english: Was that... a doll, just now?

Isn't it amazing? It records stuff
and plays it back.
dialog.translation:
Increíble, no? Graba cosas
y las reproduce.

dialog.english: It's a souvenir for Kari.
Ah, for Kari.

Yeah, it's impossible for a doll
to talk...
dialog.translation:
Ya, es imposible que un
muñeco hable...

dialog.english: Yeah, yeah! Ahahaha...

It's hoooooot. It's been so hot
lately...
dialog.translation:
Qué calooor. Hace tanto
calor últimamente

dialog.english: I mean, it's summer, isn't it?

Yeah, but it's way too hot, more
so than usual.
dialog.translation:
Ya, pero hace muchísimo más
calor de lo normal.

dialog.english: Hot!? Is it because of Meramon?
Agh, you idiot! Be quiet!
*mffffghghf*
Hm?
Did that doll just... move?
It couldn't have. Of course not...
dialog.translation: No puede ser. Claro que no...

dialog.english: Hahaha...

Seriously, though, it's getting
way too hot. I could have sworn
I'd just seen a doll moving...
dialog.translation:
En serio, hace demasiado
calor. Juraría que acabo de
ver moverse a un muñeco...

dialog.english: *whew*
Ah, Tai!
Hey, what's going on?

The weather's been kind of
strange, hasn't it? It gets hot,
and then suddenly it gets cold...
dialog.translation:
El tiempo está muy raro,
no? Hace calor y de repente
se pone frío...

dialog.english:
I know, right? I just got back
from summer camp... because there
was a snowstorm.
dialog.translation:
Ya ves. Acabo de volver del
campamento... por una
ventisca.

dialog.english: That's really bad!
Why?

I have to observe morning glories
for school! They're going to wilt!
dialog.translation:
Tengo que vigilar las
campanillas del cole! Se van
a marchitar!

dialog.english: This is a real problem!
dialog.translation: Esto sí que es un lío!

dialog.english: A problem!? Like a Digimon?
Aaaaargh! I told you not to talk!
dialog.translation: Aaaargh! Que no hables, te dije!

dialog.english: The doll! It talked!
No, you're wrong.
What am I wrong about?

WE ARE EARTHLINGS... see, *I've*
been talking.

Hmm, are you sure about that?
Well, whatever!
dialog.translation:
Mmm, seguro que es así?
Bueno, da igual!

dialog.english:
I haven't been able to catch any
bugs lately.
dialog.translation:
No he podido cazar ningún
bicho últimamente.

dialog.english:
No dragonflies or grasshoppers or
stag beetles...
dialog.translation:
Ni libélulas, saltamontes,
ni ciervos volantes...

dialog.english: Stag beetles!? Like Kuwagamon?
Agh, I told you not to talk!
dialog.translation: Ay, que no hables, te dije!

dialog.english:
...or rhinoceros beetles or
walking sticks or drone beetles...
dialog.translation:
...ni escarabajos rinoceronte,
insectos palo, ni abejorros...

dialog.english:
(Thank goodness. Seems like he
didn't hear.)
dialog.translation:
(Menos mal. Parece que no
lo ha oído.)

dialog.english: I'm home!

Tai? What happened? Weren't you
at camp?
dialog.translation:
Tai? Qué pasó? No estabas
de campamento?

dialog.english:
Y-yeah! They cancelled it because
of the snow.
dialog.translation:
S-sí! Lo cancelaron por
la nieve.

dialog.english:
Snow? What's been going on with
all this weird weather lately...
and what's that?
dialog.translation:
Nieve? Qué está pasando con
este tiempo tan raro...
y eso qué es?

dialog.english:
Oh, this? It's a souvenir for
Kari.
dialog.translation:
Ah, esto? Es un recuerdo
para Kari.

dialog.english:
Oh? You really do care about your
sister.
dialog.translation:
Ah, sí? Sí que quieres a tu
hermana.

dialog.english: T-Tai?
Moooooooooooom!
W-what's this all of a sudden?
What's wrong?
Daaaaaaaaaaaaaad!
Why were you crying just now?
Don't ask me that!
Tai!
Kari...!

Tai... did you finish what you
had to do?
dialog.translation:
Tai... terminaste lo que
tenías que hacer?

dialog.english:
No, there's still more to be done.
Anyway, Kari, about the incident 
at Karigaoka four years ago...
dialog.translation:
No, todavía queda trabajo.
Oye, Kari, sobre lo que pasó
en Hikarioka hace cuatro años

dialog.english: Do you still remember it?

Koromon got big and fought with a
huge bird, right?
dialog.translation:
Koromon creció y luchó contra
un pájaro enorme, no?

dialog.english: Yeah.
Did you forget, Tai?
Y-yeah...

Hey, Kari. Do you have a
Digivice, by any chance?
dialog.translation:
Oye, Kari. No tendrás un
Digivice, por casualidad?

dialog.english: A Digivice?
A Digivice?
Like this.
I don't have one.

You don't... yeah, of course you
don't.
dialog.translation:
No tienes... ya, claro que
no tienes.

dialog.english: Tai, I'm sleepy...
Yeah, why don't we get some sleep?
dialog.translation: Ya, por qué no dormimos ya?

dialog.english:
By the way, Tai, have you seen
Miko?
dialog.translation:
Por cierto, Tai, has visto
a Miko?

dialog.english:
I haven't. Wasn't Miko playing
outside?
dialog.translation:
No. No estaba Miko jugando
fuera?

dialog.english: Miko? What's Miko?
Our cat.
Cat? What's a cat?

I'll show you sometime. Come on,
let's go to bed.
dialog.translation:
Ya te la enseñaré. Venga,
a dormir.

dialog.english: I wonder where Miko went...
